  1. org.jwcarman.codec.spi

Uses of Package
org.jwcarman.codec.spi

Packages that use org.jwcarman.codec.spi
Package
Description
org.jwcarman.codec.autoconfigure
Spring Boot auto-configuration for the backends.
org.jwcarman.codec.crypto
Envelope encryption as a Codec<byte[]> transform: AES-256-GCM over a per-message data key that is itself wrapped by a key-encryption key reached through the DataKeyProvider SPI (in-process JCE or a remote KMS).
org.jwcarman.codec.fory
Apache Fory backend: fast JVM-only binary serialization with mandatory class registration.
org.jwcarman.codec.gson
Gson backend: a CodecFactory over any Gson instance; generics pass through as Gson TypeTokens.
org.jwcarman.codec.jackson
Jackson 3.x (tools.jackson) backend: a CodecFactory over any ObjectMapper, which makes every Jackson dataformat — CBOR, Smile, YAML, XML — a backend by mapper swap.
org.jwcarman.codec.jackson2
Jackson 2.x (com.fasterxml.jackson) backend: a CodecFactory over any ObjectMapper, which makes every Jackson 2 dataformat — CBOR, Smile, YAML, XML — a backend by mapper swap.
org.jwcarman.codec.jsonb
Jakarta JSON Binding (JSON-B) backend: a CodecFactory over any Jsonb instance.
org.jwcarman.codec.kafka
Apache Kafka integration: CodecSerializer, CodecDeserializer and CodecSerde adapt any Codec<T> to the Kafka client serialization interfaces, for producers, consumers and Kafka Streams.
org.jwcarman.codec.lz4
LZ4 frame-format compression as a Codec<byte[]> transform, backed by lz4-java.
org.jwcarman.codec.protobuf
Protocol Buffers backend: codecs for generated GeneratedMessage types, resolved through each message's static parser.
org.jwcarman.codec.redis
Spring Data Redis integration: CodecRedisSerializer adapts any Codec<T> to RedisSerializer<T> for RedisTemplate and, through its serialization pair, for the Redis cache abstraction.
org.jwcarman.codec.spi
The Codec SPI — the entire contract of codec-core: Codec encodes and decodes one type, CodecFactory produces codecs for any type, and TypeRef captures parameterized types so generics survive erasure.
org.jwcarman.codec.transform.checksum
Corruption detection: a Codec<byte[]> stage that appends a checksum on encode and verifies it on decode.
org.jwcarman.codec.transform.compress
Compression transforms: Codec<byte[]> stages that shrink a payload on the way out and inflate it on the way back, for use with Codec.andThen.
org.jwcarman.codec.transform.encoding
Text-safe encodings: Codec<byte[]> stages whose output is ASCII-only bytes, for payloads that must live in text columns, JSON strings, URLs or configuration.
org.jwcarman.codec.transform.text
Text as bytes: the Codec<String> that turns a string into its encoded bytes and back, for payloads that already are text and as a backend-free base for Codec.xmap.
org.jwcarman.codec.versioned
Format versioning for codecs: a magic-and-version header that lets an application change its storage strategy without rewriting what it has already stored.
org.jwcarman.codec.zstd
Zstandard compression as a Codec<byte[]> transform, backed by zstd-jni.

  • Classes in org.jwcarman.codec.spi used by org.jwcarman.codec.crypto
    Class
    Description
    Codec
    Converts values of type T to and from byte[].
    CodecException
    The root of every failure a Codec reports from Codec.encode(T) or Codec.decode(byte[]).
    InvalidPayloadException
    The payload handed to Codec.decode(byte[]) is malformed, corrupt, or forged: bad framing, truncation, an authentication-tag or checksum mismatch, text outside an encoding's alphabet, a corrupt compressed stream, a payload that would expand past a size cap, or one that decodes to a type this codec does not produce.
    TransientCodecException
    Something the codec depends on failed, and the input is not at fault: a key-management service timed out or throttled, a JCE provider cannot supply a transform, a compressor failed on valid input, or a provider returned something that violates its contract.

    CodecException
    The root of every failure a Codec reports from Codec.encode(T) or Codec.decode(byte[]).
    InvalidPayloadException
    The payload handed to Codec.decode(byte[]) is malformed, corrupt, or forged: bad framing, truncation, an authentication-tag or checksum mismatch, text outside an encoding's alphabet, a corrupt compressed stream, a payload that would expand past a size cap, or one that decodes to a type this codec does not produce.
